headlineFindings: Reproduced v1.1 margin MAE 10.1993 on n=2176 (pin matched).
Largest single-family lift vs CORE is success rate (~0.056 MAE); early-down / explosives / pressure / context alone do not beat CORE CI.
Closing market remains ahead (9.8543). No config closes the gap.
Flat −110 ATS on |edge|≥1 is not profitable for v1.1 despite MAE improvement vs CORE — predictive≠economic.
Tracking not measurable on pinned CSV (0 NGS columns).
